## About
MK Industries, LLC is a real estate and trading company based in Doraville, Georgia. Our work covers commercial properties, multifamily apartment homes, and food and commodity trading through MK Food & Trading.
For the properties we own, AOK Management handles all aspects of management. Our team is led by CEO Ali Katoot and includes project managers, operations directors, a property director and a construction manager.
Our motto is simple: we say what we do and do what we say. We hold a 4.3 rating from 26 Google reviews.

## Services
- Commercial Properties: Locations for businesses looking for the right place to operate.
- Multifamily Housing: Apartment homes, with service for residents aimed at a comfortable and convenient lifestyle.
- Management services: AOK Management handles all aspects of management for the properties MK Industries owns.
- MK Food & Trading: Buying and selling foods and other commodities in global markets.
- Logistics: The logistics of moving products across land or ocean.
